# Fine Art Tutorials

> > Comprehensive online art education platform offering structured courses, eBooks, and tutorials in drawing fundamentals, figure drawing, and classical art techniques.

Fine Art Tutorials is an online art education resource founded by Emily Clare, providing self-paced courses and digital products focused on foundational drawing skills, classical methods like the Loomis technique, and figure drawing instruction for artists at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Drawing Fundamentals
- Figure Drawing
- Loomis Method
- Portrait Drawing
- Drawing Mastery eBook
- Sight-Size Method
- Art Techniques
- Beginner Tutorials
- Online Courses
- Fine Art Education
- Drawing Guides
- Perspective & Shading
- Artist Community
- Classical Art Methods
- Digital Learning

## Courses & Learning Programs

- [Fine Art Tutorials Courses](https://courses.finearttutorials.com): Main courses hub featuring Drawing Fundamentals and Drawing Mastery eBook
- [Drawing Fundamentals](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/drawing-fundamentals): Self-paced online course covering Loomis method and figure drawing fundamentals

## Digital Products & eBooks

- [Books](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/books): eBook products including Drawing Mastery and Complete Drawing Guide
- [Drawing for Beginners eBook opt in](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/drawing-for-beginners-ebook-opt-in): Free eBook opt-in landing page for Complete Drawing Guide for Beginners

## About & Community

- [About](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/about): About Fine Art Tutorials and founder Emily Clare's art instruction background
- [Contact](https://courses.finearttutorials.com/contact): Contact page for reaching Emily and Fine Art Tutorials via email or social media
